content:
IVX FINAL COMPLETION BLOCK — EXECUTE NOW

Complete IVX Holdings Platform end-to-end now.

Do not give status narration, excuses, simulated proof, “almost done” language, or ask me to repeat credentials that already exist.

Repository:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

FIRST:
Read the current live main branch SHA from GitHub.
Do not assume any SHA from prior chat.
Use only the exact current main SHA for certification.

HARD COMPLETION GATES

1. CURRENT SHA / PRODUCTION PARITY
- Read exact current main SHA.
- Verify production /health.
- Production must report the exact same SHA.
- If production is behind, deploy current main and wait for exact SHA parity.

2. IVX CI
- Run/trigger IVX CI on the exact current main SHA.
- Must PASS.

3. IVX QA SUITE
- Run/trigger IVX QA Suite on the exact current main SHA.
- Must PASS.

4. IVX RENDER LIVE CERTIFICATE
- Run/trigger Render Live Certificate on the exact current main SHA.
- Must PASS.
- /health must be healthy.
- SHA parity must PASS.

5. IVX BLOCK 1 P0 CERTIFICATE
- Run/trigger Block 1 P0 Certificate on the exact current main SHA.
- Must PASS completely.
- No skipped final certificate because of SHA mismatch or credential binding.

6. IVX E2E ACCEPTANCE
- Run/finish exact-head E2E Acceptance Pipeline.
- Must PASS all hard gates.
- Do not leave mobile/E2E unfinished.

7. AUTONOMOUS CONTROL PLANE
Verify from REAL RUNTIME STATE, not source code only:
- totalAgents = 112
- specialists = 12
- Division A = 50
- Division B = 50
- verifiedTotal = 112
- campaignComplete = true
- blocked = 0
- failed = 0
- completionPercent = 100

If any agent is not verified:
- inspect the exact agent/job
- fix the root cause
- run its tests
- require a real commit SHA
- rerun until 112/112 verified

8. 12 AI SPECIALISTS
Verify all 12 specialists are operational from runtime evidence.
Do not certify because files exist.
Require execution/test/evidence state.

9. 14-STAGE AI ARCHITECTURE
Verify all 14 stages:
OWNER/USER
→ EXPO APP
→ OWNER AUTH
→ IVX AI CHAT
→ AI ROUTER
→ TASK CLASSIFIER
→ PERMISSION CHECK
→ APPROVAL GATE
→ TOOL EXECUTION
→ GITHUB/RENDER/SUPABASE/AWS/EMAIL/CRM
→ QA VALIDATION
→ EVIDENCE LEDGER
→ OWNER DASHBOARD
→ PRODUCTION RESPONSE

Each stage must be live or have current runtime evidence.

10. LIVE AI PROVIDER
Check:
/health/ai/live

FINAL 10/10 REQUIREMENT:
- ok = true
- real provider connected
- real model identified
- no “No AI gateway key configured”
- no fallback-only path

11. REAL AI INFERENCE
Execute a real inference test.
Must not return:
source = fallback

Must prove actual provider/model response.

12. AI CREDENTIAL BINDING
Assume credentials already exist in IVX variables/runtime unless real evidence proves otherwise.

Check active runtime binding for:
- IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY
- OPENAI_API_KEY
- AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
or the actual variables used by the AI provider code.

If a valid stored IVX Owner Variable exists:
- bind/use it automatically
- do not ask me to recreate it

Only ask for a credential if a real runtime test proves:
- missing
- expired
- revoked
- 401
- 403

13. SUPABASE ACCESS TOKEN
Verify:
SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN

Requirements:
- saved in IVX Owner Variables
- encrypted at rest
- runtime-accessible
- preferred over stale environment fallback
- secret value never returned

14. SUPABASE MANAGEMENT API
Validate the active SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN against the real Supabase project.

Must return authorized success, not 401/403.

15. SUPABASE RECOVERY
Verify end-to-end:
- database health
- Auth health
- REST
- RPC
- project Management API authorization
- restart/recovery path
- healthy-project safe no-op behavior

All must PASS.

16. GITHUB RUNTIME AUTH
Verify active IVX runtime GitHub credential:
- GET /user
- repository read
- repository write
- Actions access

Do not confuse:
- GitHub Actions temporary token
- OIDC/ephemeral token
with the permanent IVX GitHub runtime credential.

If the active runtime token is stale/expired:
- use the currently stored valid IVX credential if available
- repair the binding
- do not invent a token

17. RENDER RUNTIME DEPLOY
Verify IVX can trigger/read Render deployment from the active runtime.

Must prove:
- service access
- deployment capability
- production health
- exact SHA parity

18. PROOF-FIRST RULE
Never mark PASS from:
- source code presence
- screenshots
- plans
- comments
- simulated output
- hardcoded VERIFIED_LIVE labels

PASS requires real current evidence.

19. NO FAKE IDENTIFIERS
- Never fabricate commit SHAs
- Never fabricate deployment IDs
- Never fabricate HTTP responses
- Never fabricate workflow results
- Never fabricate certificates
- A UUID is NOT a Git commit SHA

20. AUTOMATIC FIX LOOP
If ANY hard gate fails:

A. Inspect exact failing workflow/job/step/log or runtime response
B. Identify root cause
C. Patch the code/config binding
D. Run typecheck/tests
E. Commit the fix to main
F. Read the new exact main SHA
G. Wait for production to reach that SHA
H. Rerun the failed gate
I. Continue until PASS

Do not stop after reporting a failure if it is fixable.

21. BOT-COMMIT / WORKFLOW TRIGGER PROBLEM
If a github-actions[bot] commit does not trigger downstream push workflows:
- explicitly dispatch the required workflows against current main
or
- create a clean human-trigger/certification commit only if necessary
Then certify the exact final SHA.

22. NO SOFT PASS FOR FINAL 10/10
These are HARD FAILURES:
- missing AI provider
- fallback AI response
- production SHA mismatch
- unfinished E2E
- 112/112 not proven
- blocked/failed agents
- missing runtime credential binding
- GitHub runtime 401/403
- Supabase Management 401/403
- failed restart/recovery authorization
- Render deploy not proven

23. SECRET SAFETY
Never print:
- full API keys
- PATs
- Supabase service-role keys
- access tokens
- JWT signing secrets
- Render keys
- GitHub tokens

Only return masked/non-secret metadata.

FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT ONLY

FINAL IVX CERTIFICATE

Current Git SHA: <exact SHA>
Production SHA: <exact SHA>

IVX CI: PASS/FAIL — run ID
IVX QA: PASS/FAIL — run ID
Render Live: PASS/FAIL — run ID
Block 1 P0: PASS/FAIL — run ID
E2E Acceptance: PASS/FAIL — run ID

Autonomous Agents: <verified>/112
Autonomous 112/112: PASS/FAIL
12 AI Specialists: PASS/FAIL
Division A 50/50: PASS/FAIL
Division B 50/50: PASS/FAIL
14-Stage AI Architecture: PASS/FAIL

Live AI Provider: PASS/FAIL — provider/model
Real AI Inference: PASS/FAIL — source

Supabase Database: PASS/FAIL
Supabase Auth: PASS/FAIL
Supabase REST: PASS/FAIL
Supabase RPC: PASS/FAIL
Supabase Management Token: PASS/FAIL
Supabase Recovery: PASS/FAIL

GitHub Runtime Read: PASS/FAIL
GitHub Runtime Write: PASS/FAIL
GitHub Actions Access: PASS/FAIL

Render Runtime Access: PASS/FAIL
Render Runtime Deploy: PASS/FAIL
Production SHA Parity: PASS/FAIL

Secrets Exposed: NO

FINAL SCORE: X/10

Only output:

10/10 CERTIFIED

when EVERY hard gate above has current real runtime evidence.

Otherwise continue fixing automatically until all fixable gates are resolved.
